roadmap.timeNote: about 200 hours (up to 300 per Push Square)
roadmap.estimateNote: Planning weights total about 200 hours. Story trophies allocate 1–2 marginal hours each; the 60–80h story phase also overlaps optional missions and activities. A Long Road carries about 110 hours of shared route and completion work. Other weights allocate activity, collectible and cleanup effort. These weights are estimates, not measured unlock times; do not add roadmap phase totals again.

steps.title: Story + optional missions
steps.text: Take the balcony meditation, scan vehicles and study animals as you play. Keep manual saves at chapter boundaries.

steps.title: 100% Completion Checklist + challenges
steps.text: Use the post-story checklist and finish 70 of the 80 challenges.

steps.title: Strangers & Freaks + cleanup
steps.text: Check which stranger strands qualify and finish outstanding trophies.

steps.text: Collect the other 54 trophies; the list has no online or DLC requirements.
Check the PS5 trophy list once the last requirement is done; the platinum unlocks on its own.
Start Jason’s story and play its opening job, Gone Fishing.
Finish that mission for an automatic unlock.
Play through the end of Chapter 1.
Begin What’s in the Bag? in Chapter 2 to trigger the award.
Clear the second chapter of the main story.
Continue into Welcome to Vice City in Chapter 3 for the automatic unlock.
Finish Chapter 3 of the story.
Keep playing through Ocean Beach and Another Life; the award comes after those opening Chapter 4 missions.
Make your way through Chapter 4.
Clear Starting From Zero, the last job of the chapter, to unlock this automatically.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Finish the last main story mission in Chapter 5.
After the credits, use free roam for outstanding trophies.
Follow the main missions until Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
Finish Breakfast Run for the automatic story award.
Advance to The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Complete the heist mission to earn the story trophy.
Reach Child’s Play in the Chapter 4 story.
Complete the job; there is no separate trophy objective.
Play the Chapter 4 story up to Headliners.
Finish Headliners and the story grants the trophy.
Follow the Chapter 4 missions to VCIA Takedown.
Clear that mission to trigger the award.
Advance to Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Finish the mission for an automatic story unlock.
After the credits, check Progress › Stats › 100% Completion; qualifying work from the story already counts.

Follow the checklist below and check off its categories in game. Many use partial targets, but robberies, underwater discoveries, range golds, drone races and Bret’s decks require their full listed totals.
Choose 250 stunts from 130 jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-bridge flights are a quick place to start.
Use Progress › Activities › Stunts or the map’s Exploration › Stunt Spots view to find gaps. Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

steps.text: Sample fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (make a basket), a video game, a race and a stunt. Car races, race challenges and Top Fun can count for racing.
Use Progress › Activities to see what you still need after story and checklist work.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps.text: Collect all 42 shooting challenge golds across the 12 ranges.
Use the range time to build Focus for Gunslinger while you work through the medals.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

steps.text: Take first in one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
Clear the other trials at each stop too if you’re pursuing the 42-race completion requirement.
Win 20 unique races out of 40; repeat wins on one course won’t advance the total.
Check Progress › Activities › Racing for your tally. The 100% checklist wants 30 wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.text: After Feng Shui in Chapter 1, look for Cal’s text and the purple fishing marker west of Key Lento. Follow his fishing jobs.
Use a boat equipped with a rod for the face-off. Push Square reports a Parrotfish heavier than 2 kg as the requested catch.
Choose one full game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind at home, or Bang For Your Buck on a cabinet.
Play through to the ending once. Individual challenge completion is unnecessary.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

steps.text: Use Lucia in Chapter 3 and follow Andy’s message to Belville to start his strand.
Work through Climbing the Cellerichain and the following quests until Puff Puff Pass. The strand stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

steps.text: Meet Kenton after Island Dreams in Chapter 1. Dive the seven marked wrecks, dig for the chests with the detector and return the finds.
If the strand goes quiet, wait for Kenton to text Jason again in Chapters 2–3. See Progress › Collections › Kenton’s Treasures for the tally.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, start Billy’s strand at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete the five jobs through Hometown Heroes; you can finish after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

steps.text: Finish eight qualifying strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are verified examples.
Exclude Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie from this count.
Check the PS5 counter after other strands because the complete qualifying list is unconfirmed. You can clean them up after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

steps.text: Finish Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS in Chapter 3, then take the 16 requested cars to Randy’s green RK marker in west Vice City.
Use WAiNK to check sports cars against the list. East Vice City and Ocean Beach are good areas to look.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps.text: Play Jason’s Chapter 3 job Here, Kitty Kitty and follow the purple Take Out Kitty Litter lab markers.
Keep clearing lab sites until Tyrone offers Spin On This, then finish that mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps.text: Track the 18 meditation credits in Progress › Collections › Exploration › Meditations. A shared meditation can add one credit for each character.
In Chapter 1, follow Lucia to Jason’s balcony when she suggests meditating and accept the optional prompt. This location closes after Chapter 1; whether the credit is required is unconfirmed.
Finish the shared meditation work after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when both characters can roam together.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps.text: As Jason, wait for Bret Vogel’s text after Coffee Break and start Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Follow his requests at the marked hunting spots.
Collect Bret’s Killtelligence SM-69 from an Ammu-Nation weapon locker if you need the rifle again.
The exact animal trigger is unconfirmed. Completing all 15 Target Decks is the suggested route, with no verified guarantee.
Assemble any three of the 18 card sets.
Continue to 15 sets for the 100% checklist. Push Square reports that selling cards at pawn shops retains credit.
Open WAiNK with hold Up, then R1, and scan 100 entries from landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher Tags.
Check Progress › Collections › WAiNK Locations. The 100% checklist has the same scan target.
Choose 50 of the 80 challenges using Progress › Challenges.
Build toward 70 for the 100% checklist, leaving out the ten you find most difficult.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

steps.text: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call the other character using hold Right and Triangle. In game, get a four-star wanted level with your partner and escape together.
You can get this during a Chapter 4 bank vault job, which triggers four stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, take your partner to three green robbery markers in succession while the in-game wanted level stays active.
For one in-game route, use the north Vice City jewelry stores after Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs. Allow time for the trophy to register after the third store.
Record 100 different vehicles by entering them or scanning with WAiNK. Taking the wheel is optional if you scan.
Scan traffic from a busy road and keep going afterward: the 100% checklist asks for 200 distinct base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.text: While aiming in game, press L3 and R3 to activate Focus and take out five enemies during that one activation.
Use a Gang Operation for targets; gang members have been reported to count. Raising Focus through activities such as the shooting range gives you more room to complete it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps.text: At VCIA in game, pick a passenger plane attached to a terminal bridge, such as E3 or E4, and use the bridge stairs to reach the cockpit.
Back the plane toward the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km from the airport.
In Leonida, find an in-game Rhino in the south section of Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County.
Get into the Rhino and use it against in-game enemies until the award registers.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.text: Clear Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to unlock the in-game jewelry jobs and Snap Gun.
Complete a jewelry job without setting off the game’s detection, then leave the store and wait for the unlock. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is the reported test location.
Complete the optional in-game Chapter 4 mission That’s Where The Money Is… to open the bank-vault jobs.
Use Yasmani’s $10,000 in-game tips to locate more vaults. Finish five distinct jobs and escape the wanted zone after each.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

steps.text: Play the optional Chapter 4 mission That’s Where The Money Is…
Complete the mission’s vault job and escape. It gives credit toward the armored truck trophy.
Use a plane to uncover the dark areas on Leonida’s map.
Keep flying over any unrevealed patches until the entire map is clear and the trophy registers.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

steps.text: Complete an illegal operation in game for each of the nine gangs. Look for yellow icons as you approach.
Check your coverage under Progress › Gangs. You’ll need all 39 operations for the completion checklist.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps.text: Visit the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and order an Apple Martini.
Drink it beside the bar. PowerPyx is the source with a detailed method.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

steps.text: Get the Key Cloner from Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS in Chapter 3, then head to the south Vice City showroom.
Take the blue Banshee, drive through the showroom glass and continue onto the street. Other showroom cars do not qualify.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

steps.text: Start Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2 or revisit when the gang marker returns. Find the watch in the southeast office, the unique shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hall.
Collect all three valuables and escape in game. The pickups can be split across visits.
After Coffee Break, buy a fitness membership and invite your partner to train together. Joint workouts build progress for both.
Check the Strength heart under Touchpad › Jason & Lucia and bring both stats to maximum at the same time.
Enable Criminal Profile alerts under Settings › UI › HUD Notifications to see actions that affect the profile.
Track the 500-action total on the PS5 trophy and let your in-game encounters and jobs build the count.
After Credit Check in Chapter 3, take Lucia alone to the Little Cuba Payday Loans in Vice City.
Complete the in-game holdup like the prologue, then leave on foot. Allow time and distance for the delayed unlock.
Go alone to the road northwest of Starlet Motel after 2 a.m. in game. Look for flashing car lights and try another pass if nothing spawns.
Follow the bright blue light into the woods, approach the UFO, offer to help the woman and head back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

steps.text: Find a crowded Leonida street and get on a bike.
Use Square for the in-game kick and land ten within a minute. PowerPyx documents this method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.text: After Credit Check, collect in-game marked bills from banks and Payday Loans and turn them in to a Fence such as Yasmani.
Build up $250,000 across jobs. The vault jobs unlocked in Chapter 4 are a large source and overlap with 100% work.
Track a cumulative $100,000 in purchases across the game’s shops.
Use expensive purchases such as weaponry, car modifications and tattoos to build the total faster.
Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to get the Vice City Real Estate app.
Spend the combined $160,000 on all eight purchasable garages. The four story garages don’t count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.text: Get Scooter Bros after the Chapter 2 mission Moses and buy garages for storage.
Take cheap vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, use Respray then Register, and repeat until you have ten.
Start with cars without trackers. From Chapter 3, Pay ’n’ Spray can also register Standard Tracker vehicles.
